citation.authors: van Leeuwen WMA, Sallinen M, Virkkala J, Lindholm H, Hirvonen A, Hublin C, Porkka-Heiskanen T, Härmä M
citation.title: Physiological and autonomic stress responses after prolonged sleep restriction and subsequent recovery sleep in healthy young men

population.description: Twenty-three healthy men aged 19-29 years (mean +/- SD 23.1 +/- 2.5; the age range is the enrolment range, not an observed range), screened by telephone interview, physical examination, blood tests and polysomnography; 15 randomised to sleep restriction (EXP), 8 controls (CON). No BMI is printed. The same cohort as vanleeuwen-2010 (the paper cites its design and inclusion criteria to that study, ref. 43). The per-cell n of Table 1 is not printed; the ANOVA dfs imply fewer than the randomised 15 (heart rate EXP 10, RR interval EXP 12).

protocols.name: baseline_night_exp
protocols.description: Experimental group (EXP), a baseline night: in bed 23:00-07:00 (paper: 'spent the first two nights 8 h in bed (baseline, BL; from 2300 to 0700 hours)'; 8 h = 480 min, minutes 0-479 asleep, awake afterwards), then the cardiac recording of 10 min supine rest 'between 0800 and 0900 hours' (minutes 540-599; window 540-600). The paper does not say whether this is the morning after the first or the second baseline night; both nights are the same, so one night is entered. Starts from typical values (norm_center), no meal: the paper gives a 21:30 snack (200 kcal) and breakfast at 08:00 (600 kcal), both without grams, and does not say whether the recording came before or after breakfast, so the fed state is unknown and no fast or meal is assumed. Only heart rate and blood pressure are entered, as markers that hardly depend on the meal.

findings.description: Resting heart rate at 08:00-09:00 after a baseline night, experimental group (Table 1, Heart rate, BL, EXP); mean of the 10-min supine recording, arm window 540-600 min; n = 10 from the printed repeated-measures df, F(2,18) = 6.29 (Results), not the 15 randomised
